fields.description:
Spun from 73d8-4871-1b49-4047 (brainy-convulsant-unicorn) and 551b-1a30-ac2b-4127 (sanidine-cilium-eland) during the 2026-08-30 error-code decision pass.

## Problem
`error_code_for` (`src/rebar/_errors.py`) maps the broad `LLMError` family to `llm_unavailable`. That over-claims an AI-provider outage for non-outage faults: the bare `LLMError` base, bare/non-outage `WorkflowError` cases, and concrete LLM/workflow subclasses that are not in the provider-unavailability subtree. This is the residual of origin 8a31-e1c3-cf31-4239's blanket mapping and the systematic completion of epic 3405-c0b7-0436-4b46's descriptiveness intent.

## Operator decision
The latest DECISION NEEDED comment approves narrowing `llm_unavailable` to true LLM availability failures only. The implementation keeps `isinstance(exc, LLMUnavailableError) -> llm_unavailable`, intentionally including the existing `LLMConfigError` / prompt / reviewer configuration subtree because those classes inherit from `LLMUnavailableError` and are already modeled as missing LLM dependencies, credentials, or configuration. The implementation removes the broad `isinstance(exc, LLMError) -> llm_unavailable` catch-all so bare `LLMError` and non-availability subclasses no longer claim an outage.

Preserve dbca AC3 without message sniffing. Production execute-step outages already propagate as `LLMUnavailableError`; a compatibility wrapper `WorkflowError` raised from a real `LLMUnavailableError` cause/context also maps to `llm_unavailable`. Plain/bare `WorkflowError` with no outage cause, including the missing-bundle case from `src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor.py:475`, maps to `command_failed`. Do not route on error message text. Do not add `environment_unready`.

Ticket 73d8-4871-1b49-4047 is folded into this sweep by giving `ExpressionError` an explicit `error_code = "invalid_input"`, matching prior bug 35ab-f0e0-3e4a-4b72 (unknown-step -> invalid_input) and dbca-97ac-ad96-4d6d (parse/lint -> invalid_input).

## Implementation scope
Touch `src/rebar/_errors.py`, `src/rebar/llm/workflow/executor.py`, and tests. Enumerate every concrete subclass of `LLMError` across `src/rebar/llm/`, including `errors.py`, `findings.py`, `evals/eval.py`, `prompting/`, and `workflow/`, with Serena hierarchy/reference checks and a grep/string confirmation. Update the existing pinned contract tests that currently assert the blanket mapping: `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_error_code_taxonomy_contract.py`, `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_llmrunner_error_codes_f75f_heldout.py`, `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_workflow_error_codes_35ab.py`, and `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_workflow_error_codes_dbca.py`.

Intended mapping: `LLMUnavailableError` and its availability/config subtree -> `llm_unavailable`; production `LLMUnavailableError` execute outages and cause/context-wrapped `WorkflowError` outage compatibility cases -> `llm_unavailable`; `ExpressionError` -> `invalid_input`; workflow caller/authoring errors already classified as `invalid_input` stay there; every remaining LLM/prompt-independent/findings/eval/snapshot subclass without an explicit `error_code` -> `command_failed`; plain/bare `WorkflowError` without outage cause -> `command_failed`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `src/rebar/_errors.py` returns `llm_unavailable` for `LLMUnavailableError` / `LLMConfigError` availability errors, for production execute-step outages propagated as `LLMUnavailableError`, and for `WorkflowError` cause/context chains containing `LLMUnavailableError`; focused tests verify both execute-outage paths.
- [ ] Plain/bare `WorkflowError` without an outage cause maps to `command_failed`; the editor missing-bundle case from `src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor.py:475` is covered by a focused test and does not map to `llm_unavailable`.
- [ ] The broad `LLMError` base and every non-availability `LLMError` subclass not classified by an earlier workflow-caller or availability branch maps to an explicit `error_code` when present, otherwise `command_failed`; a parameterized taxonomy test covers the complete enumerated subclass set.
- [ ] `ExpressionError` maps to `invalid_input` via an explicit `error_code`, verified by a focused test and by the exhaustive taxonomy test.
- [ ] No `environment_unready` code is introduced; `KNOWN_ERROR_CODES` remains consistent with the intentional taxonomy.

## Testing
Run the focused updated contract tests with `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest -q tests/interfaces/contracts/test_error_code_taxonomy_contract.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_llmrunner_error_codes_f75f_heldout.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_workflow_error_codes_35ab.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_workflow_error_codes_dbca.py`, then `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` and `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`. After committing, run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" rebar verify-commit-ticket HEAD`.
